messages.summary:
## Objective
- Add named crew members with individual health to the existing Last Light survival game.
- Make random events injure or heal crew, and lose the run if all three die.

## Requirements
- Show three crew names below the stat bars.
- Event cards should update a crew member’s status.
- Build directly without asking clarifying questions; verify the result, including a small JPEG screenshot.

## Decisions
- Added Mara Venn, Eli Torres, and Jun Park as the crew.
- Crew health effects are randomly applied when an event appears, then reflected after the player chooses an option.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a responsive crew roster with individual health bars and FIT/WOUNDED/CRITICAL/DOWN statuses.
- Added occasional named crew injury/healing updates to event cards.
- Added a loss condition when all three crew members are dead.
- JavaScript syntax check and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Verify the game in a browser, including crew names and an event updating a crew status.

### Blocked

## Objective
- Add Scrap-based neon market stops every 25 miles and a 10-second drone-shooting Scavenge mini-game to the survival game in `index.html`.

## Requirements
- Market stops pause travel; leaving resumes the run.
- Fuel and Rations cost 8 Scrap for 20 units; a Medkit costs 12 Scrap and heals the most injured living crew member by 35 vitals.
- Scrap accrues at 1.2 per mile.
- Scavenge pauses travel; drone hits reward Food, Fuel, and Scrap. Verify resources increase after returning to the road.

## Decisions
- Retain crew vitals and injury mechanics so Medkit healing has a purpose.
- Each drone hit rewards +2 Fuel, +2 Rations, and +2 Scrap.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added market UI, Scrap HUD and accrual, trading, pause/resume behavior, and crew healing.
- Added Scavenge button and mini-game UI, tap-to-shoot drones, 10-second timer, hit tracking, loot display, and return-to-road rewards.
- JavaScript syntax validation passed; `git diff --check` passed.
- Browser-tested a temporary market copy: market opened at 25.2 miles, trades worked, and leaving resumed travel.

### Active
- Browser-test the Scavenge flow: launch, shoot a drone, wait for the timer, return to the road, and confirm resources increase.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Browser-test Scavenge behavior and resource gains.
2. Address any issues found and rerun syntax validation and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Contains the game, market features, and Scavenge implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status` showed only `M index.html`.
- Scavenge browser verification is still pending.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Add randomized crew traits, visible tags, trait-specific survival-event choices, and passive travel effects while preserving existing gameplay and mini-games.

## Requirements
- Assign each crew member one random positive trait and one random negative trait at run start.
- Show colored trait tags under crew names; show a gold or red third event choice when a living crew member has a matching trait.
- Apply passive travel effects, including increased Rations use for Gluttons and extra Scrap from Scavengers.
- Keep existing gameplay and mini-games intact.

## Decisions
- Positive and negative trait tags are green/gold and red; special choices use gold for positive traits and red for negative traits.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added randomized trait assignment for all three crew members and rendered their trait tags.
- Added trait-matched special choices to survival events, with keyboard selection for choice 3 and Scrap delta handling.
- Added passive Glutton Rations consumption and Scavenger Scrap gains.
- Preserved the existing Scrap market and 10-second drone Scavenge mini-game.

### Active
- Validate JavaScript syntax, review the diff, and test the trait flow and existing gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run syntax checks and `git diff --check`.
2. Review `index.html` for correct trait assignment, event-choice eligibility/effects, and passive calculations.
3. Test the game in a browser, including the event choices and existing mini-games.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, crew data and rendering, event definitions and choices, travel resource updates, and mini-games.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is the project file changed.
- No validation or browser testing has been run since implementing traits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Add randomized crew traits, visible tags, trait-specific survival-event choices, and passive travel effects while preserving existing gameplay and mini-games.

## Requirements
- Assign each crew member one random positive trait and one random negative trait at run start.
- Show colored trait tags under crew names; offer a gold or red third event choice when a living crew member has a matching trait.
- Apply passive travel effects, including increased Rations use for Gluttons and extra Scrap from Scavengers.
- Keep existing gameplay and mini-games intact.

## Decisions
- Positive and negative trait tags are green and red; special choices are gold for positive traits and red for negative traits.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added randomized traits for all three crew members, visible trait tags, and matching special event choices.
- Added keyboard selection for choice 3, Scrap deltas, and passive Glutton and Scavenger travel effects.
- Preserved the Scrap market and 10-second drone Scavenge mini-game.
- `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Review/fix any issues found in the diff and validate gameplay behavior.

### Blocked
- Browser testing has not been run.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the event-choice flow and verify special-choice eligibility and effects.
2. Test the game in a browser, including trait tags, travel effects, event choices, Scrap market, and drone mini-game.
3. Re-run `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js` and `git diff --check` after any fixes.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, crew traits and rendering, event definitions and choices, travel resource updates, and mini-games.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is the only modified file.
- An earlier attempt to check syntax through process substitution failed with `ENOENT`; extracting the script to `/tmp/opencode/game.js` and checking that file succeeded.

## Objective
- Add randomized crew traits, visible tags, trait-specific survival-event choices, and passive travel effects while preserving existing gameplay and mini-games.

## Requirements
- Assign each crew member one random positive trait and one random negative trait at run start.
- Show colored trait tags under crew names; offer a gold or red third event choice when a living crew member has a matching trait.
- Apply passive travel effects, including increased Rations use for Gluttons and extra Scrap from Scavengers.
- Keep existing gameplay and mini-games intact.

## Decisions
- Positive and negative trait tags are green and red; special choices are gold for positive traits and red for negative traits.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added randomized traits for all three crew members, visible trait tags, matching special event choices, and keyboard selection for choice 3.
- Added Scrap deltas, passive Glutton and Scavenger travel effects, and crew-health updates.
- Preserved the Scrap market and 10-second drone Scavenge mini-game.
- JavaScript syntax check and `git diff --check` passed earlier.

### Active
- Review/fix issues found in the diff and validate gameplay behavior.

### Blocked
- Browser testing has not been run.

## Next Move
1. Inspect event-choice eligibility and effects, including how crew health changes interact with special choices.
2. Test in Chromium: trait tags, travel effects, event choices, Scrap market, and drone mini-game.
3. Re-run JavaScript syntax and whitespace checks after any fixes.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, crew traits and rendering, event definitions and choices, travel resource updates, and mini-games.

- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is the only modified file.
- Current check used `/tmp/opencode/game.js` extracted from the inline `<script>`; the earlier process-substitution syntax-check attempt failed with `ENOENT`.
- Chromium is installed at `/usr/bin/chromium`; no Playwright, Puppeteer, or jsdom package was found.

## Objective
- Add randomized crew traits, visible tags, trait-specific survival-event choices, and passive travel effects while preserving existing gameplay and mini-games.

## Requirements
- Assign each crew member one random positive trait and one random negative trait at run start.
- Show colored trait tags under crew names; offer a gold or red third event choice when a living crew member has a matching trait.
- Apply passive travel effects, including increased Rations use for Gluttons and extra Scrap from Scavengers.
- Keep existing gameplay and mini-games intact.

## Decisions
- Positive and negative trait tags are green and red; special choices are gold for positive traits and red for negative traits.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added randomized traits for all three crew members, visible trait tags, matching special event choices, and keyboard selection for choice 3.
- Added Scrap deltas, passive Glutton and Scavenger travel effects, and crew-health updates.
- Preserved the Scrap market and 10-second drone Scavenge mini-game.
- Earlier JavaScript syntax and `git diff --check` checks passed.

### Active
- Review event-choice eligibility and effects, including how crew health changes interact with special choices.
- Validate gameplay in Chromium.

### Blocked
- Browser testing has not been run; Playwright, Puppeteer, and jsdom were not found.

## Next Move
1. Inspect event-choice eligibility and effects, particularly matching trait availability and crew-health updates.
2. Test in Chromium: trait tags, travel effects, event choices, Scrap market, and drone Scavenge mini-game.
3. Re-run JavaScript syntax and whitespace checks after any fixes.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, crew traits and rendering, event definitions and choices, travel resource updates, and mini-games.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is the only modified file.
- Earlier syntax validation extracted the inline `<script>` to `/tmp/opencode/game.js`; an earlier process-substitution syntax-check attempt failed with `ENOENT`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Add randomized crew traits, visible tags, trait-specific survival-event choices, and passive travel effects while preserving existing gameplay and mini-games.

## Requirements
- Assign each crew member one random positive trait and one random negative trait at run start.
- Show colored trait tags under crew names; offer a gold or red third event choice when a living crew member has a matching trait.
- Apply passive travel effects, including increased Rations use for Gluttons and extra Scrap from Scavengers.
- Keep existing gameplay and mini-games intact.

## Decisions
- Positive and negative trait tags are green and red; special choices are gold for positive traits and red for negative traits.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added randomized traits for all three crew members, visible trait tags, matching special event choices, and keyboard selection for choice 3.
- Added Scrap deltas, passive Glutton and Scavenger travel effects, and crew-health updates.
- Preserved the Scrap market and 10-second drone Scavenge mini-game.
- Validated trait tags and a matching third choice in Chromium; the special choice appeared with gold styling.
- Earlier JavaScript syntax and `git diff --check` checks passed.

### Active
- Finish Chromium validation of event-choice effects, crew-health updates, passive travel effects, the Scrap market, and the drone Scavenge mini-game.
- Re-run JavaScript syntax and whitespace checks after any fixes.

### Blocked
- The Chromium test script errored while inspecting the state after pressing `3`; the choice was displayed, but its effect was not confirmed. Scavenge and market interactions remain unverified.

## Next Move
1. Fix the Chromium test’s post-choice inspection and confirm choice effects and crew-health updates.
2. Validate passive travel effects, Scrap market, and drone Scavenge interactions in Chromium.
3. Re-run JavaScript syntax and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, crew traits and rendering, event definitions and choices, travel resource updates, and mini-games.
- `/tmp/opencode/cdp_test.py`: Temporary Chromium DevTools test script; its post-choice state inspection currently errors.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is the only modified repository file.
- Chromium is available at `/usr/bin/chromium`; a remote-debugging Chromium instance was restarted with `--remote-allow-origins='*'`.
- Chromium displayed randomized crew tags and a gold `[Tinkerer]` third option for “THE STRANDED”; post-choice effects remain unconfirmed.

## Objective
- Add randomized crew traits, visible tags, trait-specific survival-event choices, and passive travel effects while preserving existing gameplay and mini-games.

## Requirements
- Assign each crew member one random positive trait and one random negative trait at run start.
- Show colored trait tags under crew names; offer a gold or red third event choice when a living crew member has a matching trait.
- Apply passive travel effects, including increased Rations use for Gluttons and extra Scrap from Scavengers.
- Keep existing gameplay and mini-games intact.

## Decisions
- Positive and negative trait tags are green and red; special choices are gold for positive traits and red for negative traits.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added randomized traits, visible tags, matching special event choices, and keyboard selection for choice 3.
- Added Scrap deltas, passive Glutton and Scavenger travel effects, and crew-health updates.
- Preserved the Scrap market and 10-second drone Scavenge mini-game.
- Chromium confirmed colored trait tags and a gold `[Tinkerer]` third option for “THE STRANDED”; the event showed a crew health update.

### Active
- Confirm event-choice effects and crew-health updates in Chromium.
- Validate passive travel effects, Scrap market, and drone Scavenge interactions.
- Re-run JavaScript syntax and `git diff --check`.

### Blocked
- The Chromium test hit an error inspecting state after choice 3; its inspection expression was edited, but the test has not yet been rerun successfully.

## Next Move
1. Run `/tmp/opencode/cdp_test.py` with `python3 -u` and fix any remaining post-choice inspection errors.
2. Complete Chromium checks for the event effect, travel effects, Scrap market, and drone Scavenge.
3. Re-run JavaScript syntax and whitespace checks.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, traits, events, travel resource updates, and mini-games.
- `/tmp/opencode/cdp_test.py`: Temporary Chromium DevTools test script; post-choice inspection was recently corrected but remains unverified.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is the only modified repository file.
- Chromium displayed the randomized traits and gold special choice; the test reported `CREW UPDATE / MARA VENN — TREATED +22 VITALS`.
- A subsequent tool call intended to rerun the test used the edit tool with shell arguments and failed; the corrected script still needs to be run.

Implemented in `index.html`:

- Crew members receive one randomized positive and one negative trait at run start, displayed as green and red tags.
- Events can offer a color-coded third choice when a living crew member has a matching trait; pressing `3` selects it.
- Gluttons increase ration use during travel, and Scavengers boost passive Scrap gains.
- Trait choices can change supplies and hull health, and crew-health updates are applied when an event is resolved.

Validated the event choice and crew update in Chromium, along with travel gains, the 10-second drone Scavenge game, and a Scrap-market trade. JavaScript syntax and `git diff --check` passed.
